h: Naira posts fresh losses as CBN adjusts the dollar rate, despite $55.2bn in reserves
p: The Central Bank of Nigeria has adjusted its official dollar exchange rate, and the naira has recorded fresh losses. This comes even though the country's foreign reserves are reported at $55.2 billion. Analysts are watching how the currency moves in the coming days.
more: Reserves of $55.2bn are among the highest in recent years.
The naira has been under pressure in the official market this week.
